notes: EFCA congregation in Tucson with two weekend services (9:00 family, 10:30 main). Street address could NOT be confirmed: one search snippet mentioned 4700 N Swan Rd but that looked like an EFCA regional office rather than the church, so it was deliberately not recorded. Find the address and the church's own website/sermon host before reviewing. Jim Roden has published an academic case study about this church, which is a useful independent writing sample for comparison. A YouTube channel was later found at youtube.com/journeychurchtucson - search results describe it as 'Journey Church Tucson, an Evangelical Free Church located in Tucson, AZ', which matches this congregation, but confirm the channel belongs to this church and not a similarly named one.
